question: A man receives ₹7,420 per month as salary. He saves 35% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total salary represents 100% of the income.

Expenditure % = 100% − Savings %

⇒ Expenditure % = 100% − 35% = 65%

⇒ Expenditure amount = 65% of 7420 = (65 ÷ 100) × 7420 = 4823

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,823.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Monthly Salary = ₹7,420

Savings = 35%

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure = Total Income − Savings

 Total Salary = 100% (₹7,420)
 
 Savings: 35%
 
 Expenditure: 65%
 
• 
 0.35 × 7420
 
• 
 Exp = 0.65 × 7420

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Salary percentage = 100%

⇒ Expenditure percentage = 100% − 35%

⇒ Expenditure percentage = 65%

⇒ Expenditure = 65% of 7420

⇒ Expenditure = (65 ÷ 100) × 7420

⇒ Expenditure = 0.65 × 7420

⇒ Expenditure = 4823

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,823.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings

Total Income is always the sum of Savings and Expenditure. The base value for calculating percentage distributions is always taken as the total income (100%).

Percentage Multiplying Factor

To find X% of any quantity, simply multiply the quantity by its decimal equivalent (X ÷ 100). For example, 65% translates directly to a multiplying factor of 0.65.
